knownFacts.statement: Keycard badge #308 was swiped at Vault 4 at 01:15 AM.
Decompression sensor registered pressure drop at 01:15 AM.

unverifiedClaims.statement: Security guard claims door was wide open at 01:12 AM.

evidenceConnections.description: Keycard badge swipe coincides with vault atmospheric decompression.

claimA.text: Sensor log records door securely locked until 01:15 AM.

claimB.text: Officer visual inspection claims door was open at 01:12 AM.

contradictions.explanation: Guard observation precedes badge swipe and decompression timestamp.

hypotheses.description: Authorized badge holder accessed the vault at 01:15 AM.
The vault was breached earlier prior to the badge swipe.

openQuestions.question: Was guard watch accurate or running fast?

suggestedNextChecks.check: Audit guard time clock sync against server NTP
